ANIMAL_DOMESTICABILITY_REVIEW_2024.source: Steklis et al. 2024 Why Were Zebras Not Domesticated?
ANIMAL_DOMESTICABILITY_REVIEW_2024.use: animal domesticability is multivariate; response to humans/capture stress, social system and captive breeding can facilitate or block domestication

ANIMAL_DOMESTICATION_TIMESCALE.source: Larson/Frantz-related review 2021 Animal domestication: from distant past to current development and issues
ANIMAL_DOMESTICATION_TIMESCALE.use: animal domestication is a multi-millennial process; major livestock domestications cluster around 10.5–10 ka while dog domestication is older

DOMESTICATION_PROCESS_REVIEW.source: Kantar et al. 2018 Genomic approaches for studying crop evolution
DOMESTICATION_PROCESS_REVIEW.use: wild-managed gene flow and evolutionary divergence are retained as separate processes

DOMESTICATION_REPRODUCTIVE_REGIME.source: Lord et al. 2023 Shared reproductive disruption, not neural crest or tameness, explains the domestication syndrome
DOMESTICATION_REPRODUCTIVE_REGIME.use: sustained reproductive control is treated as a causal transition rather than a cosmetic domestication-syndrome label

FUNCTIONAL_PRIOR_AUTHORITY.use: sociality, life history, dietary flexibility and ecological generalism inform partner-screening priors with explicit latent uncertainty

H0_SPECIES_AUTHORITY.use: all ecological partner candidates are drawn from the 134 present H0 species; no new biological species are invented

HOLOCENE_DELTA_RESOURCE_CONTEXT.source: Nature Sustainability 2024 Delta sustainability from the Holocene to the Anthropocene
HOLOCENE_DELTA_RESOURCE_CONTEXT.use: postglacial sea-level stabilization and productive lowland/delta landscapes can alter resource accessibility and settlement opportunity

PALEOCLIMATE_PROVIDER.source: SEALED ARCANA v0.6.1 recent paleoclimate provider
PALEOCLIMATE_PROVIDER.use: 100-year global history and 21/14/12.9/12/0 ka spatial temperature, precipitation, NPP and land-mask snapshots are consumed directly

PROTRACTED_DOMESTICATION.source: Fuller et al. 2017 Geographic mosaics and changing rates of cereal domestication
PROTRACTED_DOMESTICATION.use: domestication is modeled as a prolonged trajectory rather than an instantaneous threshold
